job_story: When a customer texts asking to move a booking, I want to answer with suitable free times in under 2 minutes, so I can keep my evening free.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant has an inbound reschedule SMS and at least 3 free slots in the next 7 days When the owner opens the message Then a draft reply with up to 3 proposed slots from that tenant's calendar is shown within 5 seconds; Given a draft reply is shown When the owner has not tapped approve Then 0 messages are sent and 0 bookings are created for that draft

job_story: When I approve a proposed time, I want to book the slot and confirm it to the customer in one step, so I can avoid double handling.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner approves one proposed slot When the approval is submitted Then a booking is created in that tenant's calendar and one confirmation message is queued within 10 seconds

job_story: When the assistant suggests a message, I want to see where the suggestion came from, so I can trust what goes out in my name.
acceptance_criteria: Given a draft reply is shown When the owner expands the sources Then the inbound message and every calendar slot used (up to 3) are listed with their IDs within 2 seconds

job_story: When I look back at my week, I want to see every message the assistant drafted, so I can spot mistakes.
